main_body: A magenta vending-machine-like cabinet. A grey-blue top block (rows 0-5) sits above a pink band (row 6), then a magenta front face (rows 7-30) holding a recessed glass window with shelves and products and a small dark slot.
top_band: grey-blue band rows 1-5 (L 118-148) above a pink line at row 6. It reads as a small separate sign/cap block with its own front face and is not a horizontal top surface. The main magenta body (rows 7-30) has no top surface at all.
evidence: In the column scan the magenta body (L 69) starts at row 7 and runs down to row 30 as a single vertical face. The grey-blue block on top is a header or sign panel drawn face-on, with a darker slot and highlight bands. It is not the top of the cabinet. The pink row 6 is a 1-row edge line, which is too thin to be a top. The body has no lighter horizontal band for a top surface, so this is a front elevation of a vending machine with a hat. The inset window and shadows are good, but they are all on the vertical face.

style.evidence: The candidate has 22 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references. Flat-fill coverage is 0% and the dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted dark magenta rather than black. There are several steps on the magenta body (deep, mid, dark) and on the grey-blue header, and the window carries coloured product pixels with highlights. The magenta body is rather smooth, with little grain, but the density holds up against the references.
